round3decision.text:
Decided in Round 3

• Site map A: two tabs, Games and Performance
• Game detail opens as a drawer
• Past days: date control on Games
• Model: a strip in Performance showing whatever production_model is (68.2% today); leaderboard deferred
• System: header pill + popover; Run now only on the Flask computer
• Audience: public viewers too, read-only

round4decision.text:
Decided in Round 4

• Date rail (option 2), but only on past nights
• Tonight: 'Past nights' button + 'All past nights ›' link open last night
• Past night: rail with a Tonight cell, date as title, night recap hero, final cards
• Performance filters by NBA season
• Keep the 'Paper trading' tag

round5decision.text:
Decided in Round 5

• Detail drawer A (tale of the tape) now; B (why the pick) later, once factor contributions are stored
• Toolbar option 1: filter tabs with counts + sort tabs
• Finals show Hit/Miss from live scores, tagged unofficial; the DB still settles at 6 AM
• Toasts + 10s outline flashes; reduced motion drops the flash
• Sample fix: SAC bet is $55.58 (¼-Kelly, 5% cap)

round6decision.text:
Decided in Round 6

• Hero once every bet has tipped: B, 'Tonight so far'
• Move predictions to ~1 hour before first tip (settle + retrain stay at 6 AM)
• Skipped games (no odds / missing data) get logged and shown as no-bet cards
• Postponed games: void, return the paper stake
